We have not treated those unavailable lists as current evidence. Wanzl’s Caroline’s Cart page has product information, safety literature and a store request form. Caroline’s Cause tells the origin story. How we know what we know. Official store pages supply addresses and phone numbers. The cart evidence is linked separately below. Policy listings describe a retailer’s published provision; chain reports do not confirm a specific branch; older local reports need reconfirmation.
